title: Prove SaladUI compatibility in a disposable LiveView app
outcome: Fable verifies the chosen package works with the pinned native Phoenix stack.
scope: Create a throwaway app using proposed pins; inspect setup changes and package CSS class scanning.
Test representative native form controls, validation, patch/reconnect, focus and interaction alongside a minimal Tips-style hook.
Record accepted versions before real scaffold and later P16 setup.
acceptance: Actual generated assets render styled controls with no lost events/focus across patches.
Native selects/details and server-rendered errors remain; no React state layer.
Compatibility failures update proposed pins before consumers start.
verification: Disposable browser smoke, version record and setup diff.
sizing: One design baseline with reader/editor exemplars; does not wait for M2 or include final running-screen approval.

title: Establish Fable-owned visual direction and shared component interfaces
outcome: Feature owners receive a concrete native-Phoenix visual baseline before broad screen work.
scope: Fable or Opus designs compact shadcn-language reader/editor compositions and essential loading/error/recovery states.
Define tokens, spacing/type scale and required component interface/ownership against pinned SaladUI compatibility evidence.
acceptance: Reviewable responsive reader/editor artifacts cover 320px reflow and keyboard focus, not only ideal desktop screenshots.
Native selects/details, page-owned state and server errors remain; no React, forced component catalogue or unrequested dark mode.
Baseline artifact decisions unblock implementation independently of final feature QA.
verification: Fable design review and shared component interface sign-off; reference P0 compatibility result.
ownership: Fable-owned reviewable visual artifacts in docs/design/visual/
Token/component interface notes in docs/design/visual/ with linked consuming code once implemented.
sizing: One design baseline with reader/editor exemplars; does not wait for M2 or include final running-screen approval.

title: Implement required SaladUI tokens and shared native components
outcome: Pages can consume a tested visual baseline without toolkit ownership of product state.
scope: Integrate selected SaladUI package mode and required layout/form/button/status primitives under exclusive shared-file ownership.
Review setup changes to CSS/hooks/layouts and preserve Tips-specific event ownership.

Publish actual shared component paths and interfaces; Search, Browse and Voting tasks consume these and request changes from the shared UI owner under reservation rather than concurrently editing the files.
acceptance: Dependency CSS classes appear in built assets; representative validation/focus/live-patch/reconnect controls work.
Native select/details behavior and server-rendered errors remain; components carry no second draft/search/upload state.
Shared interfaces and usage examples exist beside code; adapt only concrete required components, not a general library fork.
verification: Pinned dependency asset build and representative LiveView/browser component smoke; accessibility/focus review by Fable.
ownership: Shared UI owner designated by Fable exclusively owns shared HEEx components/layouts including tip-row, filter, page-navigation and vote-control components.
Design tokens/styles and JS registration coordinated with P0 under explicit file reservation.
sizing: One required component baseline; if too many unrelated controls appear, implement only first reader/editor needs and dispatch later additions by consuming task.

title: Review visual consistency and usability on all completed page areas
outcome: Fable confirms real screens match the visual baseline and preserve failure/recovery usability.
scope: Review browse/search, tip/reviews, publish/edit, accounts/profiles, inbox and moderation on integrated revision.
Record precise page/state findings and send bounded repairs to owning task; include known missing-description limitation.
acceptance: Loading, empty, validation, disconnection, conflict and provider-failure states are legible at desktop/mobile/zoom.
Keyboard focus/status announcements and 320px reflow verified on actual pages; no design-only claim substitutes for runtime test.
No P0/P1 visual/usability findings remain; lower-priority findings recorded and accessibility conformance not claimed without evidence.
Final QA depends on feature completion but baseline tasks remain independent, preventing dependency cycle.
verification: Fable reviewed-screen/state matrix with revision and browser/device evidence; linked repair/review records.
ownership: Visual acceptance report and bounded follow-up findings
sizing: One final cross-page review gate; fixes remain owned changes and independent reviewers use separate sessions.

title: Define editor intent and browser recovery interfaces
outcome: Both editor kinds and their hooks share one concrete intent, identity and recovery contract.
scope: Specify text intent, explicit blanks, complete edit base, draft identity/revision and publication result shapes beside code and representative fixtures.
Specify page/hook events, account/form identities and later media slot extension points without implementing media behavior.
acceptance: Tip/review fixtures include new/edit/recovered/handoff modes and unknown media identity.
The contract distinguishes browser draft revision, server edit_version and publication key.
No success stub or parallel normalization ruleset is introduced.
verification: Review concrete fixtures/types with Accounts, Search, Media and editor owners; identify the actual files downstream tasks must read.
ownership: Content intent/result types and focused contract fixtures
sizing: One interface decision with examples; split implementation out, and resolve contradictory outcomes before marking downstream work Ready.

title: Implement canonical content intent normalization and comparison
outcome: Publication retries and edits agree about equivalent, different and unknown complete intent.
scope: Implement one Content comparator for normalized author-editable fields.
Include setup blanks, tag, ordered media identity and descriptions; media fixtures may precede adapters.
acceptance: Identical text/setup/order/description normalizes equivalently; a change in any editable field differs.
Unknown image identity, missing slot or incomplete intent yields unknown rather than an empty attachment list.
Counters, timestamps and moderation state do not enter editable comparison; incomplete base disables conflict shortcut.
verification: Focused comparator tests covering Unicode/whitespace rules from the schema and complete/incomplete intent tables.
ownership: Content normalization/comparison module and unit tests
sizing: One pure contract implementation; split additional parsing/validation concerns if they require provider or browser behavior.

title: Commit new text publications and their required side effects atomically
outcome: A tip or review inserts exactly one publication, self-vote, search row and eligible review notification.
scope: Implement text-only publish_tip and publish_review transactions against canonical constraints.
Implement the minimal notification fold needed by review publication; use Search-owned writer and database counter triggers.
acceptance: A new tip/review receives its self-vote and current search text in the same commit; no self notification is created.
Review publication requires a live parent and independent submitted setup including cleared blanks; same-author one-undeleted-review is enforced.
Duplicate key/constraint races resolve after rollback with equivalent/different/unknown receipts before another-key already-reviewed response.
Publication versus ban or parent hide/delete is tested with independently committed transactions and ordered locks; failure leaves no partial dependent writes.
verification: Content publication transaction tests with actual canonical constraints/triggers.
Explicit synchronized two-connection retry and eligibility-race tests.
sizing: One atomic publication behavior for both table variants; split tip/review implementations only if initial context estimate exceeds one session, preserving shared side effects.

title: Save guarded text edits without replaying publication effects
outcome: Eligible authors edit current content with one version guard and truthful conflict/uncertain outcomes.
scope: Implement consistent editable snapshots and text edit operations using the original expected version.
Use shared comparator/search writer and return the current authorized state after failed guards.
acceptance: Current-version real edit increments version once and updates edited_at; current-version no-op changes neither; stale no-op fails.
Votes, original dates, ranking inputs, notification timestamps/count/read state remain unchanged; hidden content stays hidden.
Changed search text invalidates embedding transactionally; review edits need no parent-tip lock when liveness is unchanged.
Deletion, full ban, ownership loss and uncertain commit preserve explicit failure outcomes; no automatic version advancement.
verification: Content edit tests including stale/no-op and search freshness assertions.
Synchronized edit versus account/visibility mutation tests.
ownership: Content edit operations and snapshot projection
sizing: One versioned text-edit behavior; attachment transaction work belongs to P6/P8.

title: Provide early author-delete and guarded hide/restore primitives
outcome: Early slices can prove visibility and deletion without waiting for the complete moderation screens.
scope: Implement author deletion plus minimal moderator hide/restore operations against current admission and canonical visibility.

Resolve applicable flags/notifications for text-only content. P6.03 must extend this real operation to transactional media cleanup before any media lifecycle gate; do not install a successful placeholder cleanup callback.
acceptance: Full-ban authors may delete owned content but cannot edit; rejected actions change no dependents.
Tip hide/delete preserves independently visible reviews and their media; deletion takes precedence and cannot be restored.
Hide/restore compares edit_version and reviewed report state, changes version but not author dates, and never replays publication notifications.
Review liveness mutations lock parent tip before review so counter triggers and later bulk operations share lock order.
verification: Content liveness/deletion tests on canonical schema; verify metadata/projection masks through shared policy.
Synchronized single-review liveness schedule against a representative bulk lock transaction.
ownership: Content deletion and minimal Moderation operations
sizing: One content-lifecycle boundary; split delete and hide/restore into separate children if implementation requires unrelated module work, retaining both before early video gate.

title: Implement account-scoped text draft CAS storage
outcome: Browser drafts cannot overwrite or clear a newer draft from another tab.
scope: Implement IndexedDB record creation/save/discard/clear with draft_id and revision CAS.
Store text/selections/key/base metadata; reserve media descriptors without persisting file bytes.
acceptance: Two first writers cannot both create the account/form record; missing/replaced record conflicts even at the same numeric revision.
Autosave and clear guard both identity and revision, preserving newer work after stale save/discard.
Storage failure allows composing/publishing and reports unsaved risk; no localStorage or server-draft fallback.
Account/form scoping prevents another account from restoring values.
verification: Real-browser IndexedDB tests using separate tabs, delayed transactions, discard/recreate and quota/availability failure.
ownership: Browser draft storage module and browser tests
sizing: One browser persistence boundary; hook mount/restore and publication orchestration remain P3.07/P3.08.

title: Mount text editors with safe draft restoration and reconnect recovery
outcome: Authors resume the correct text draft without overwriting typing or changing account/form identity.
scope: Create one page LiveView per content kind with new/edit actions and page-owned state.
Wire draft mount, pristine-DOM checks, IndexedDB restore and same-page DOM reconnect recovery to the settled interfaces.
Initialize review setup only on a fresh form; retain explicit blanks and immutable edit base across recovery.
acceptance: Typing before hook mount or during delayed storage read is preserved; restore applies only while pristine, and late callbacks after fallback/destruction are ignored.
Reconnect uses DOM form recovery without IndexedDB restore; account/form, key, blanks, original base/version remain intact.
Review setup initializes once from parent, stays clearable and is never refilled after restore/edit; required Other technique is available.
verification: LiveView tests for form identity/defaults and real-browser hook tests for typing before/during restore, reconnect, delayed/failed storage and stale callbacks.
sizing: One editor mount/recovery lifecycle; submission validation and expired-auth presentation are P3.09.

title: Reconcile text publication acknowledgements and clear only submitted drafts
outcome: Lost responses and same-key divergent drafts never erase unacknowledged work.
scope: Wire explicit publish/retry and bounded get_publication recovery with immutable submitted values.
Clear/navigate only for created or equivalent receipts plus successful submitted-revision CAS; preserve divergent proposals for later explicit handoff.
For unknown text edit outcome, retain proposal and read current authorized saved state; never use publication-key lookup as proof of the edit or blindly replay with a new version.
acceptance: Simultaneous different drafts sharing a key return truthful comparison; identity-only/deleted/unknown receipts cannot clear local values.
Lost acknowledgement triggers bounded reconciliation; absent allows explicit same-key retry without assuming prior request stopped.
Lookup failure remains unresolved with Check again/Sign in; no background republish loop.
Newer local edits or failed clear CAS remain recoverable and are not labelled published or navigated away.
Lost edit acknowledgement leaves proposal available beside current saved state; any further edit is explicit and retains the normal expected-version guard.
verification: Real-browser text publish/edit lost-response slice with two tabs and intercepted responses.
Context receipt and LiveView clear/navigation assertions.
sizing: One publication acknowledgement boundary; edit conflict choices and K/E handoff remain separate later tasks.

title: Validate text submissions and preserve input after authorization expiry
outcome: Text editors present complete actionable errors while keeping unsaved input through refused saves.
scope: Wire Content changeset validation to submit-first errors and correction-on-change after a failed submit.
Implement linked focusable error summary, disclosure opening and current-admission failure presentation without forced reload.
acceptance: Publish/Save validates all required text including untouched fields; preserve long pasted values without maxlength and use a single validation presentation.
First failure focuses the summary and errors open optional evidence disclosure; subsequent correction clears stale errors without autosave/reconnect triggering validation.
Expired admission or full ban preserves current text and draft, displays the relevant explanation and carries validated return destination; no automatic save follows sign-in.
Required Other technique exists in the seeded vocabulary; review optional setup remains clearable and independently stored.
verification: LiveView changeset/error lifecycle tests and browser summary-link focus/disclosure/auth-expiry input-preservation checks.
ownership: Editor validation/admission presentation handlers and templates
sizing: One submission validation and refused-save presentation boundary; no additional draft-storage lifecycle.

title: Retain image selections through publish/edit rejection and uncertain outcome
outcome: An image remains selected after known failure and is consumed only after confirmed success.
scope: Integrate page-owned LiveView image entries with Media upload attempt and Content transactions for publish/edit.
Freeze immutable attempt values; validate text before file consumption; retain entry paths only for their owning lifetime.
acceptance: Invalid text and definite rate-limit rejection retain image/text and require explicit same-key retry.
Failure on a later image cleans only confirmed unattached attempt objects and preserves every valid selection.
Lost commit response reconciles before consumption/cleanup; unknown outcome never implies rollback or deletion permission.
Successful commit attaches the correct stable media row and description; edit replacement/cleanup rolls back on stale version.
verification: LiveView upload lifecycle tests plus real-browser retained-selection retry.
Injected later-file failure/unknown commit tests through actual Content/Media boundary.
sizing: One image submission ownership boundary; do not add multi-file UX, drag helpers or async task staging unless measured blocking demands the existing page-owned option.

title: Prove the integrated image journey against R2
outcome: A real image can be uploaded, read and cleaned while rejection retains usable editor state.
scope: Run real R2 journey using isolated asset identifiers; record revision/environment/cleanup.
acceptance: Known rejection followed by explicit retry publishes exactly once with the original selection.
Read path renders valid image, hides/deletes through current projection, and confirms required deletion/cache purge.
A stub or unavailable R2 configuration cannot pass this gate; operational blocker is recorded.
verification: Recorded browser run and provider object/purge evidence with sanitized identifiers.
sizing: One provider journey and evidence; fixes return to responsible coding tasks rather than accumulating unrelated changes in a gate.

title: Extend content lifecycle operations to durable media cleanup
outcome: Author deletion and deliberate visibility changes preserve the agreed independent media lifecycle.
scope: Extend early text lifecycle operations to attached-media visibility and transactional durable cleanup using real Media operations.
Use fixture-attached media to test lifecycle independently of editor submission.
acceptance: Deleting content clears only its own live media membership and enqueues actual cleanup in the same transaction; rejected delete changes neither content nor media/jobs.
Tip hide/delete preserves independently visible review media; hide/restore only changes authorization and makes no provider activation/deletion write.
Cleanup rows retain provider identifiers until confirmed provider deletion/cache purge; unknown outcomes do not authorize early object deletion.
Banned authors retain owned-content deletion; no placeholder cleanup callback can report success.
verification: Content lifecycle transaction tests with actual media rows/jobs, cleanup retry and independent review-media assertions.
sizing: One content-lifecycle extension; image selection/upload/retry remains P6.01.

title: Integrate one private video with resumable upload and bounded status
outcome: A selected video reaches durable readiness without blocking writing or duplicating assets.
scope: Wire external LiveView preflight to durable media identity and tus adapter; persist identity/order before transfer completes.
Implement one page-owned nonoverlapping status cycle using selected pending IDs and committed Media transitions.
acceptance: Pause/resume or file reselection uses the same valid asset; one-hour transfer deadline never extends; no duplicate preflight on reconnect.
Pending processing/status timeout or rate limit keeps writing responsive with bounded backoff; ready rows need no provider read.
Selection change/unmount cancels old cycle, and late status/preflight responses cannot restore removed/cleanup-marked media.
Publish remains explicit and blocked until selected video is playable; expired/failed row retains its place with replace/remove actions.
verification: Real-browser tus adapter tests against controlled endpoints and LiveView tests of timer/task lifecycle.
Injected slow/rate-limited/out-of-order status results.
sizing: One video editor integration; split tus adapter and page status ownership if their combined required context cannot retain repair reserve, using the settled event contract.

title: Prove real private video publication playback hide and deletion
outcome: The first real Stream journey proves private creation, readiness, access and cleanup on integrated code.
scope: Exercise actual browser tus and signed player/thumbnail routes against configured private Stream.
acceptance: Video is private from reservation; upload/processing/ready are distinct and cannot auto-publish.
A ready video publishes during status-provider outage and plays through fresh authorized app routes without provider activation writes.
Hide stops new ordinary-reader tokens, restore respects current visibility, and author deletion enqueues eventual provider deletion; issued token expiry is documented.
A visible review video remains usable under hidden/deleted parent; no stale status response revives removed rows.
verification: Sanitized revision/environment/provider evidence; browser playback and hide/delete checks; tracked fixture cleanup.
sizing: One real-provider lifecycle gate; unavailable access remains blocked rather than accepting a simulated upload.

title: Complete ordered mixed-attachment editing transactions
outcome: Both editors save one complete ordered media selection with descriptions and guarded cleanup.
scope: Extend publication/edit integration to up to ten mixed retained/new images and staged videos.
Validate ownership/uniqueness/limits and defer media slot constraints only inside the guarded edit transaction.
acceptance: Swaps retain stable IDs/descriptions; duplicates, foreign assets, another target and eleven total attachments fail atomically.
Only new images count toward decimal 50 MB aggregate and 10 MB each; videos keep separate 1 GB/three-minute limits.
Stale edit cannot change attachments or enqueue cleanup; removed assets retain provider identity for durable cleanup.
Unknown file identities remain unknown for publication comparison; missing restored slots never become an empty selection.
verification: Content transaction tests for reorder/swap/mixed limit and stale edits; LiveView combined-selection tests.
sizing: One ordered-selection persistence behavior; preview and reorder interaction hooks remain separate tasks.

title: Add accessible attachment selection and reorder controls
outcome: Drag, keyboard and touch users can select and reorder the same attachment identities.
scope: Route supported paste/drop to existing image/video configurations and append without replacing text.
Add maintained drag helper plus Move earlier/later controls with preserved focus and announcements.
acceptance: Full ten-item mixed tray supports end/middle/long-distance moves; descriptions and durable IDs move with items and no re-upload occurs.
Touch hold does not capture ordinary scroll; keyboard buttons disable unavailable directions and announce changed positions.
Invalid selection preserves other files/text; combined count includes retained media and neither drop nor paste bypasses backend limits.
Hook DOM ownership leaves server readiness/errors/remove controls patchable.
verification: Browser keyboard/touch-equivalent drag/drop/paste tests and full-tray reorder persistence run.
sizing: One selection/order interaction boundary; no second client upload/progress store.

title: Render static composer previews with safe lifecycle cleanup
outcome: Local image previews never animate and late decoding cannot corrupt a replacement attachment.
scope: Draw one downscaled canvas frame for image/GIF/WebP/APNG and release URLs/decoder references on removal/unmount.
Keep named preview-unavailable fallback and explicit Show/Hide where static decoding is unsafe.
acceptance: Animated formats remain still on selection, restore and LiveView patch; failed decode never falls back to autoplaying img.
Description policy supplies accessible name; filename is not alternative text.
Late decode after replacement/removal is ignored, and server controls remain current alongside ignored canvas subtree.
Large-source memory and responsiveness are measured honestly; downscaled destination does not claim bounded decode memory.
verification: Browser fixture tests across supported matrix for large static/GIF/WebP/APNG, decode failure and patch/unmount.
ownership: Composer preview hook and fixture tests
sizing: One browser preview lifecycle; source decoding limits found in measurement become explicit follow-up decisions rather than another image pipeline.

title: Restore missing image slots and recoverable staged videos
outcome: Reopened drafts retain every attachment position and clearly resolve missing or expired evidence.
scope: Extend draft descriptors/recovery to image reselection and durable staged videos; retain named unresolved positions.
acceptance: Missing images retain filename/type/size/order/description and bind reselect to the chosen slot; publish stays blocked until resolve/remove.
Recovered completed videos show readiness/expiry without extending 48-hour recovery window; expired/missing assets retain place.
verification: Real-browser refresh/reselection/storage-failure and delayed video restoration tests.
sizing: One media-draft restoration boundary; exit risk and discard belong to P8.08.

title: Recover edit conflicts with explicit unchanged-base or manual-reapply paths
outcome: Authors retain their proposal and can resolve a stale edit without silently overwriting newer content.
scope: Implement shared-comparator unchanged-base shortcut and preserved read-only proposal reference for changed/incomplete bases.
Handle unknown edit responses by reading current authorized state without blind replay.
acceptance: Moderation-only version change with equal editable base offers explicit Save at current version and preserves hiding; another race may still reject.
Retag/description/order/content changes or incomplete base require explicit load-latest/manual-reapply.
Reference survives partial reapply, reload and tab eviction; second conflict does not replace an unresolved reference.
Storage failure keeps visible at-risk proposal; destroyed attachments cannot be restored; auth loss preserves input.
verification: Browser conflict scenarios plus Content comparator/guard tests including hide-restore ABA and lost edit response.
ownership: Editor conflict state and draft reference integration
sizing: One conflict resolution state machine; no automatic merge, version bump or background retry.

title: Carry divergent publication proposals into edit without re-upload
outcome: A differing or unknown receipt can become an explicit edit while preserving page-owned files and unrelated drafts.
scope: Patch same-kind new editor into exact-item edit action with current authorization/base/version.
Retain original K draft record as edit-mode proposal; offer explicit K/E choice without moving/copying either record.
acceptance: Image entries/previews/tus adapters survive in-place handoff; exact-item ready staged videos attach without rebind/re-upload.
Save/discard K clears only submitted K revision and leaves unrelated E unchanged; E later gets normal stale-version recovery.
Back/new-form URL, refresh and reconnect retain logical edit mode after account/target checks.
Deleted originals cannot be exposed/edited; ban/auth loss preserves proposal; lost edit response never uses original publication key as edit proof.
verification: Real-browser K/E coexistence with selected images/ready video, refresh/Back/reconnect and storage failure.
Content target-equivalence rejection for another user/item/parent.
sizing: One publication-to-edit transition with bounded two-record coordination; split only if backend exact-item rule has not already landed in Media contract.

title: Verify full editor behavior and bounded browser usability
outcome: Complete tip/review editors meet accessibility and responsiveness requirements under realistic maximum input.
scope: Run supported browser/device matrix over both editor kinds with ten delayed attachments and maximum text.
Record responsiveness/memory measurements and repair actionable failures in owning tasks.
acceptance: Keyboard ordering, focus/error summary, 320 CSS px reflow/zoom and meaningful status-change announcements work.
Ten delayed attachments do not block writing; publish readiness updates automatically without auto-submit.
Real IndexedDB, tus and hooks run; simulated LiveView upload tests alone cannot pass.
Any page-owned async publication change is justified by measurement and retains entry lifetimes/uncertain-outcome rules.
verification: Browser matrix report tied to revision, fixtures, initial performance budgets and pass/fail measurements set by foundation probe.
sizing: One integrated editor evidence gate; if a performance limit needs architecture change return to tech lead rather than expanding the gate into redesign.

title: Protect at-risk editor exits and confirm draft discard
outcome: Authors get a leave warning only when work could be lost, and explicit discard cannot erase another draft revision.
scope: Implement conditional native leave warning using existing saved/dirty/conflict/file state and ordinary editor exit anchors.
Implement once-confirmed discard guarded by draft identity/revision and reconciled publication outcome.
acceptance: Safely saved text plus recoverable processing video needs no warning; unsaved/conflicted text, new images or unfinished transfer does.
Cancel discard keeps values; confirmed discard clears only matching draft revision, never published attachments, and triggers no second leave warning.
Audit every editor exit including logo/account links; uncertain publication must reconcile before discard and leaving is not cancellation/discard.
Storage failure retains input and at-risk feedback; native warnings remain best effort with autosave independent.
verification: Real-browser editor exit/close/reload and cancel/confirm discard matrix including storage failure, CAS conflict and uncertain publication.
ownership: Editor leave/discard hook and event integration
sizing: One exit-risk and explicit discard boundary; no new storage mechanism or navigation history subsystem.

title: Build minimal safe tip and selected-review projections from fixtures
outcome: Early authoring receives readable destinations without depending on publication code.
scope: Implement minimal tip/selected-review read operations using canonical fixture rows and shared Content visibility policy.
Return own-review identity/current capabilities and authorized evidence metadata without raw association leakage.
acceptance: Deleted originals are masked for everyone; hidden originals only visible to current author/moderator; visible reviews remain independent.
Selected review lookup ignores list filters/page and never substitutes another review when unavailable.
Anonymous public read needs no token lookup; privileged projections require current admission and stop after revoked session even if disconnect fails.
Own hidden review remains reachable/deletable for fully banned owner under removed/deleted parent.
verification: Projection matrix tests using fixture inserts, not publish functions; unauthorized metadata/slug/title checks.
sizing: One minimal read contract; full browse/ranked review lists remain P9b.

title: Render minimal tip and single-review routes in initial HTML
outcome: Published text and early media have honest readable destinations before broad screen expansion.
scope: Wire minimal public page routes/templates to projections with text rendering, placeholders, capabilities and evidence extension points.
Render Markdown safely and verbatim Prompt/Result with meaningful selected-review states.
acceptance: Disconnected and first connected HTML show readable projected content; no deleted title leaks in metadata/slug/link.
Hidden/deleted tip placeholder keeps permitted review; selected unavailable review shows correct supplied reason without substitution.
Contribution header prioritizes Your review and current deletion capability; unavailable parent without own review does not create sign-in dead end.
Author-hidden notice is generic and contains no reporter details.
verification: Controller/LiveView disconnected/connected HTML tests with projection fixtures.
sizing: One minimal readable destination; no feed filters, complete visual polish or inbox work.

title: Implement browse paging and shared context-preserving filters
outcome: Readers browse Hot/New with shareable immediate filters and stable current-page state.
scope: Implement browse query/projection and URL page lifecycle with twenty rows plus lookahead.
Integrate shared selects/tip rows with Search owner through explicit interface; do not edit SearchLive concurrently.
acceptance: Technique/model/environment use exact combined AND matching on tip-author setup; unset filters produce no disabling SQL OR predicates.
Select changes keep focus and native keyboard behavior, reset page one, and Clear filters preserves applicable sort/submitted query.
Curated metadata link changes only its filter in discovery; free-text model never becomes exact-filter link.
Initial HTML is readable; out-of-range page offers Previous/First; no totals/streams/caches or automatic reorder after vote.
Back restores URL/useful reading position and accepts current-ranking drift.
verification: Browse query and LiveView navigation tests; browser focus/Back checks; query-plan evidence on target fixtures.
ownership: Consumes P16.02-owned filter/page/tip-row components; shared-file changes are assigned to the shared UI owner under exclusive reservation.
sizing: One browse/filter lifecycle; Search async/retrieval stays P4b ownership.

title: Complete ranked review reading and evidence interactions
outcome: Tip readers can filter/sort reviews and open evidence without losing selected-review semantics.
scope: Implement thirty-row normal review pages with Best/New and optional exact reviewer-setup filters.
Complete own-review actions, original/updated dates, earlier-visible-review notice and independently authorized evidence.
acceptance: Selected-review mode hides list controls and opens evidence; Show all removes selected ID, review filters/page while retaining sort; Back restores actual prior URL.
Normal review filters default All including unspecified setup; changing filter/sort resets page and preserves focus.
Earlier-review note uses only visible reviews and readable tip edit time; no hidden metadata leaks.
Stable own-review action group respects ban/delete/edit capability on header/ranked/selected views.
A functional thirty-review page renders the full required content and ordinary focus/navigation correctly; maximum-size capacity/memory measurements belong only to P14.03.
verification: Content list/projection tests and LiveView page/control tests plus a light functional thirty-review browser check; reuse these fixtures in the separate P14.03 capacity gate.
ownership: Review navigation and functional page-size tests
sizing: One review list and selected-view composition; evidence hooks are P9b.03.

title: Add explicit motion playback and exact text copying
outcome: Readers control animation/video playback and copy exact prompt/result text with honest outcomes.
scope: Render static images with descriptions, opt-in animated image controls and fresh authorized video player/thumbnail links.
Implement user-triggered Copy for nonempty raw Prompt/Result with selection fallback.
acceptance: Animated images never autoplay on disclosure/remount/vote/restore; Hide removes animation and returns focus.
Missing description has truthful fallback and separately named full-size action; filename never substitutes for alt.
Video opens through fresh authorization/no-store app routes; expired/hidden/deleted access fails honestly without public fallback.
Long Unicode/whitespace copy is byte-equivalent text and success appears only after clipboard resolution; denied copy retains selection fallback.
verification: Browser animation/remount/focus/clipboard denial tests; signed media route integration checks.
sizing: One explicit reader evidence-control boundary; provider signing itself remains Media ownership.

title: Set desired vote state atomically and return confirmed counters
outcome: Repeated vote requests cannot toggle twice or duplicate unchanged-vote notifications.
scope: Implement set_vote desired 1/-1/nil with direct-target locks and shared admission.
Extend minimal fold helper for eligible helpful-vote events; read confirmed counters after trigger writes.
acceptance: Desired-state repeats are no-ops with no extra fold; change/remove adjusts counters once and distinguishes denied operation from unchanged state.
Self votes preserve agreed behavior without self notifications; remove then helpful counts another intended event.
Review vote takes no ancestor lock; hide/delete/full-ban races serialize eligibility correctly.
Unban cannot recreate invalidated votes and vote edits never alter content edit_version.
verification: Synchronized transactional vote/visibility tests and notification fold/counter assertions.
sizing: One desired-state vote transaction for both target types; screen integration is separate.

title: Share truthful vote controls across summary and detail pages
outcome: Readers see pending/current vote state without stale intent replay or page reorder.
scope: Hydrate visible viewer-votes/capabilities in batches and share controls in summaries/details.
Allow one in-flight request per target and reconcile uncertain responses before new action.
acceptance: Summaries show net score; detail shows Helpful/Not helpful counts from server-confirmed response.
Signed-out/expired-session click returns through auth with current state and requires explicit click; no automatic replay.
Uncertain older action cannot override newer choice; only confirmed row changes, with no list rerank/cache.
Full ban removes contribution actions while own-content deletion remains available.
Actual vote controls work consistently on browse and SearchLive summaries as well as tip/review detail, using P4b shared row interface without a second voting implementation.
verification: LiveView summary/detail control parity tests and browser delayed/lost vote response tests.
ownership: Summary/detail vote event and hydration integration coordinated with page owners
Shared vote-control component changes assigned to P16.02 shared UI owner under exclusive reservation.
sizing: One cross-page vote interaction; reserve shared component ownership and coordinate Search integration explicitly.

title: Implement paged inbox with captured-count read marking
outcome: Opening inbox clears only captured unread activity while later arrivals stay unread.
scope: Implement repeatable-read inbox page/capture projection, guarded mark-read and capped badge.
Render twenty-row URL paging and one connected-visit marking lifecycle.
acceptance: Disconnected mount is read-only; first connected visit captures all unread pairs including unloaded rows; page changes do not mark again.
Fold/new row after snapshot stays unread; marking matches both id/count and account.
Targets use deletion-first projection inside snapshot; no hidden/deleted title leak via raw joins.
Vote notifications have no actor names/numeric event totals; inbox accurately describes recent activity/opening badge clearing.
verification: Deterministically synchronized snapshot/fold/read tests; LiveView disconnected/connected/page/remount lifecycle tests.
sizing: One snapshot/read-state journey; no notification dropdown, broadcast or second cache.

title: Store reports with honest receipts and deletion-safe locking
outcome: The reporting context returns truthful persistence outcomes under uniqueness and deletion races.
scope: Implement reason/detail validation and one-open report transaction.
Use confirmed eligible reporter/direct-target lock and post-rollback actual receipt lookup.
acceptance: Reason required and explanation capped at 1000 characters; fabricated label matches policy; unconfirmed/banned/deleted reporters rejected.
Report-first deletion resolves report; delete-first fails target eligibility; review report takes no ancestor-tip lock.
Existing-open receipt never claims new supplied detail saved; resolution/receipt race preserves input with uncertainty and no auto retry.
Reports never automatically hide content, change ranking or impose penalties; context errors preserve explicit uncertain/denied outcomes.
verification: Two-order report/delete transaction tests plus uniqueness/receipt-resolution races using independently committed transactions.
sizing: One reporting context transaction; sign-in return and reporting interaction are P11.10.

title: Render authorized moderation queue and reviewed case snapshots
outcome: Moderators inspect individual report details and a precise reviewable content version.
scope: Implement twenty-case grouping/order/lookahead and case read with reviewed report IDs and content version.
Render current authorized media and explicit conflict reload state.
acceptance: Queue sorts report count descending, earliest report then kind/id; page URL/remount/out-of-range behavior is consistent.
Case includes individual reasons/details, not only counts; deleted original content stays masked even for moderators.
Revoked session, removed moderator role and full ban block privileged reads even with stale LiveView scope.
Newly arriving reports are not silently included in the captured reviewed set.
verification: Privileged projection/queue ordering tests and LiveView paged case tests.
sizing: One privileged queue/case snapshot; action mutations remain separate.

title: Apply reviewed hide restore and dismissal without consuming new reports
outcome: Moderator actions reject stale content/report snapshots and preserve independent review visibility.
scope: Wire complete reviewed-set semantics and UI to early hide/restore primitives.
Implement dismiss_reports for captured IDs without visibility changes.
acceptance: Content-version or captured-report-state conflict changes nothing and requires explicit reload/retry.
Reports arriving after reviewed set stay open; dismissal neither restores visibility nor advances edit_version.
Hide/restore advances content version only on change, preserves author dates, never restores author-deleted content or individually hidden child reviews.
Author-facing removal remains generic without report detail/reason inference.
verification: Concurrent new-report/resolve/content-edit and hide-restore ABA tests; LiveView preserved selection/conflict feedback.
sizing: One reviewed-snapshot action family; no auto retry against newer versions.

title: Retag tips with author-content and search freshness protection
outcome: Moderators change only classification through the canonical version guard and search writer.
scope: Implement retag_tip through shared Search writer and add a technique selector preserving selection on conflict.
acceptance: Require active moderator, active tag and nondeleted tip; current-version unchanged tag is a no-op.
Changed tag advances edit_version once and invalidates vector/reset cooldown atomically, preserving author fields, edited_at and visibility.
A paused embedding worker with the old freshness token cannot commit after retag; stale author/moderator submissions cannot silently undo classification.
verification: Retag authorization/no-op/conflict tests and paused embedding writer versus retag integration test.
sizing: One guarded classification change and downstream search invalidation; no media action implementation.

title: Implement full-ban transitions independently from content actions
outcome: Moderators change account eligibility without implicitly hiding content or restoring votes.
scope: Implement Accounts ban/lift under sorted moderator/subject account locks; no screen work in this task.
acceptance: Ban leaves existing content visible; lift restores eligibility only and never restores content/votes/notifications/media.
Full ban blocks contributions/moderation but permits reading and own-content/account deletion.
Current moderator eligibility rechecked under locks; publication and account eligibility changes serialize without stale-scope authorization.
verification: Accounts ban/lift permission tests and synchronized publication versus ban/unban schedules.
ownership: Moderation task owner reserves the actual Accounts ban/lift implementation and test paths exclusively through Codex before dispatch; Accounts owner pauses changes to those reserved paths until integration.
Accounts ban/lift transaction tests under the same reservation.
sizing: One account eligibility context transition under an explicit Accounts file reservation; moderator controls are P11.11.

title: Prove bulk moderation capacity under concurrent voting
outcome: The agreed atomic moderation model fits request budgets on a representative large account.
scope: Run at least 10,000 reviews across many tips with concurrent votes using actual schema/triggers and normal request timeout.
acceptance: Bulk hide/vote invalidation is atomic, deadlock-free in tested schedules and within measured request deadline.
Counters and visibility match committed rows; concurrent new publication/eligibility changes obey lock order.
Failure records measurements and blocks gate; any Oban/chunking proposal requires technical review instead of raising request-pool timeout.
verification: Reproducible fixture/measurement report with revision, row counts, concurrency, latency and correctness queries.
ownership: Bulk moderation capacity fixture/test and evidence
sizing: One measured capacity gate; redesign or repair is dispatched to bounded follow-up tasks.

title: Permanently remove selected media with guarded durable cleanup
outcome: Moderators remove exactly the chosen evidence without altering text or unselected attachments.
scope: Implement selected-media removal through durable Media cleanup and once-confirmed irreversible selected-count UI.
acceptance: Selected IDs must all belong live to target; stale version or foreign selection removes nothing.
Removal advances version once, clears only selected positions, retains provider identifiers/cleanup jobs and preserves unselected text/media.
Old editor/status response cannot resurrect destroyed assets; cleanup outage does not undo committed reference removal.
verification: Stale/foreign/partial-selection transaction tests, late-editor/status rejection and durable cleanup retry checks.
sizing: One permanent selected-asset removal boundary; provider adapters and job durability are reused.

title: Hide a subject account content set atomically
outcome: Bulk hiding uses one stable account-locked target set and applies liveness counters once.
scope: Implement distinct Content bulk hide after subject-account locking, then ordered trigger parents and target rows.
acceptance: Discover affected content only after subject accounts lock so concurrent publication cannot escape the operation.
Atomic hide advances affected versions, preserves author dates/deletions, and counter triggers apply once.
Single-review liveness mutations and bulk hiding follow compatible full-schema FK/trigger lock order; no automatic coupling to ban.
verification: Independently committed two-connection publication/bulk and review-liveness/bulk schedules; rollback/counter assertions.
sizing: One atomic content-set visibility mutation; capacity evidence is the separate gate.

title: Invalidate selected vote sets under ordered locks
outcome: Moderator vote invalidation removes each contribution once and cannot be undone by unban.
scope: Implement privileged vote-investigation projection and explicit selected vote invalidation under account/parent/dependent lock order.
acceptance: Investigation returns voter identity/value/date only under fresh moderator admission, with deleted content projection respected.
Prelock subject accounts then affected tip/review parents before deleting votes; triggers subtract committed contributions once.
Concurrent votes and invalidation serialize safely; lifting a ban recreates no votes and a later explicit eligible vote is a new event.
verification: Privilege tests plus concurrent vote/invalidation schedules and counter agreement checks.
sizing: One selected-vote invalidation boundary with its required privileged read; bulk capacity remains separate.

title: Present explicit reporting and truthful receipt states
outcome: Readers report deliberately after sign-in and keep their explanation when the outcome is uncertain.
scope: Wire signed-out report intent through validated return destination and explicit report interaction.
Present required reason/detail validation, newly stored/existing receipt, expired admission and uncertain outcomes.
acceptance: Sign-in rechecks target/current eligibility and never inserts or replays the earlier report; expired admission preserves input.
Report received appears only after confirmed new persistence; existing-open feedback never claims newly supplied explanation saved.
Resolution/receipt race or interrupted result retains detail and permits explicit retry without automatic loops.
Reason label fabricated and 1000-character detail limit use context rules with input preserved.
verification: LiveView reporting validation/receipt tests and browser sign-in-return/auth-expiry/uncertain-result input preservation.
sizing: One reader reporting interaction; transaction races remain P11.01.

title: Present explicit full-ban and lift-ban controls
outcome: Moderators change account eligibility without implying that content or votes were changed.
scope: Add current-capability ban/lift controls using Accounts outcomes and keep bulk hide/vote invalidation as distinct explicit actions.
acceptance: Ban/lift feedback describes eligibility only and does not promise content restoration, hiding or vote recreation.
Stale/expired moderator access refuses action with preserved context; a disconnect failure cannot bypass context admission.
Full-ban member presentation preserves reading and own-content/account deletion paths while contributions are unavailable.
verification: Moderation LiveView ban/lift permission/error feedback tests and browser capability checks.
ownership: Moderation account controls/templates under moderation owner
Ban/lift UI tests; no Accounts implementation edits in this task.
sizing: One moderator account-control interaction; transactional state and locking are P11.05.

title: Change sign-in email through recent authentication and verified replacement
outcome: Email change preserves identity while revoking old credentials only after successful confirmation.
scope: Adapt generated request/confirm email-change operations and settings/confirmation UI.
Use existing sudo/family semantics and direct mail outcomes.
acceptance: Current email remains active until valid new-address confirmation commits; uniqueness rechecked, token bound account/old/new addresses.
Stale link cannot revert newer email or restore deleted user; failure leaves sessions unchanged.
Success revokes old sessions/auth links, issues fresh confirming-browser family and preserves account ID/handle/content/ban/drafts.
Expired sudo requests current-address reauthentication and returns to explicit operation; mailbox help offers no manual ownership override.
verification: Accounts token/uniqueness/session-family transaction tests and two-browser email-change E2E with failed disconnect.
sizing: One sensitive account-change journey; reuse auth foundation, no second token system.

title: Delete an account with explicit recent-auth confirmation
outcome: Users including banned authors can end account access while retained contributions use deleted-author presentation.
scope: Implement current-account sudo-guarded deletion and confirmation UI with token revocation in one transaction.
Clear identity fields and sign out after committed state while preserving contribution rows.
acceptance: Banned account may delete itself; expired recent auth returns to confirmation and never auto-deletes.
Handle/email clear and are reusable; tokens revoked; content remains under deleted-author label without retaining original attribution.
Confirmation explains irreversible account access loss and retained content; users can delete own content beforehand.
Lost/failed confirmation does not falsely announce deletion, and old links cannot restore account.
verification: Accounts deletion/reuse/revocation tests and browser sudo/confirmation flow; retained-content projection checks.
sizing: One sensitive deletion boundary; no bulk content deletion or recovery override.

title: Render mixed contribution profiles with current capabilities
outcome: Profiles show one deterministic list of visible tips/reviews and appropriate author controls.
scope: Implement UNION ALL contributions with kind filter before twenty-row paging and composite row identity.
Render native Contributions selector with shared focus/URL behavior and masked parent labels.
acceptance: Equal timestamps/overlapping tip-review IDs remain stable using kind/id tie-breakers; no inactive-tab cache.
Hidden rows require fresh own/moderator admission; deleted rows excluded, parent labels masked without losing visible review link.
Kind change resets page; All clears filter; out-of-range states and Back use current URL.
Banned author retains eligible delete/Your review routes while contribution controls remain unavailable.
verification: Profile query ordering/visibility/capability tests and LiveView/browser selector/Back tests.
sizing: One mixed profile list; account mutations remain separate.
